correctness.rationale: Normalize 2n iid Exp(1) coordinates by their sum to obtain the intrinsic-uniform simplex; column differences are iid continuous Laplace and sorting full pairs enforces the Monge order, with equal n! arrangement probabilities. The bijection U=W+D_+, V=W+(-D)_+ has Jacobian one and factorization Exp(2) for W independent of Laplace D. Sorting preserves original gamma row sums, giving Beta(n,n) exactly. Empirical-L1 quantile convergence for Laplace D and uniform marked LLN for W give full cumulative A,B limits, with A(1/2)=1/8, B(1/2)=3/8. The exact joint CDF of largest D and negative smallest D tends to product independent Gumbels; denominator S/(2n)=1+O_P(n^-1/2) does not change centered extremes. Independent finite sampling for n=100,2000 corroborated cumulative curves only; infinite a.s. and weak limits follow analytically.
